items.prompt:
A reference to another work, person, or event is an:
A) allusion
B) antonym
C) syllable

A comparison used to explain something is an:
A) analogy
B) idiom
C) rhyme

Which has a more NEGATIVE connotation?
A) determined
B) obsessed
C) focused

Read.

He was the Einstein of our class.

'The Einstein of our class' is an allusion meaning he was:
A) German
B) exceptionally brilliant
C) very old

Read.

Fixing the economy was like bailing out a sinking ship with a teaspoon.

This analogy conveys the effort was:
A) easy
B) overwhelming and nearly futile
C) quick

'He met his Achilles' heel' alludes to his:
A) one fatal weakness
B) great strength
C) new shoes

Read.

The critic called the mayor's plan 'a Trojan horse' for raising taxes.

The allusion suggests the plan:
A) hides a harmful purpose inside an appealing offer
B) is about ancient Greece
C) involves real horses
items.answer: A) hides a harmful purpose inside an appealing offer

steps: Trojan horse = hidden threat. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) hides a harmful purpose inside an appealing offer

items.prompt:
Why might an author use an ANALOGY to explain a hard concept?
A) to compare it to something familiar so readers understand
B) to make it more confusing
C) to avoid the topic
items.answer: A) to compare it to something familiar so readers understand

steps: Analogy aids understanding. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to compare it to something familiar so readers understand
